glutamate.name: Glutamate
glutamate.what: The brain's main “go” signal. Most fast messages between neurons use it.

gaba.name: GABA
gaba.what: The brain's main “ease off” signal. It quiets neurons so activity doesn't run away.

dopamine.name: Dopamine
dopamine.what: Signals that something is worth pursuing, and teaches the brain from rewards that beat expectations.

noradrenaline.name: Noradrenaline
noradrenaline.what: Turns up alertness inside the brain. A burst of it makes you instantly watchful.

adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
adrenaline.what: A hormone from glands above the kidneys that readies the body: faster heart, quicker breathing.

cortisol.name: Cortisol
cortisol.what: A slower stress hormone that releases energy and keeps you going for minutes to hours.

acetylcholine.name: Acetylcholine
acetylcholine.what: Tells muscles to contract, and inside the brain helps sharpen attention.

serotonin.name: Serotonin
serotonin.what: Helps regulate mood, sleep, appetite and patience. Its effects are broad and still being worked out.

endorphins.name: Endorphins
endorphins.what: The body's own painkillers, released during stress, exercise and laughter.

oxytocin.name: Oxytocin
oxytocin.what: A hormone involved in bonding and trust. Its effects depend heavily on the situation.
